mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile because the complete loop made the two journeys easier to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left-side valves felt repetitive after doing the same thing on the right, even though their purpose was clear.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the heart muscle to need its own blood vessels rather than being supplied by the blood in its chambers.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but several steps offered only one combination, so there was little choice in how to proceed.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the two routes and seeing how the heart supplies itself made me curious about how other body systems fit together, despite the repetitive valve fittings.
